author: Steve Smythe
blurb: Pip is a giant tomato who longs to do something important. Bramble is a donkey who likes to think before she takes a step. When they find a space capsule buried on their farm, Pip is ready for the biggest adventure ever. But inside is a tiny robot with a broken ship — and a very long way to go home.
makerLine: This one was made by hand with the Method. The next one could be made by you.
message: Every shelf needs a first book. This one's free, on me.
tagline: A big adventure starts with a little help.
title: A Tomato, a Donkey, and the Stars
